# Comfy Fighter Z: complete audio bundle

22 paid cloud audio jobs. Music: Sonilo. Effects: ElevenLabs SFX. Announcer, move names and fighter intro taglines: Eleven v4. Each intro uses a distinct stock preset voice for a fictional performance; it does not imitate any real person. No local model weights and no voice cloning.

Set Asset Root to the SAME folder as the image graph. Audio saves are PCM WAVs under raw/. The exporter writes audio.json only after every track finishes; assets.json remains unchanged. Load the full folder in the builder to include both maps.

Music is requested as loop-friendly; audition the joins before release. Preparing this workflow spends nothing. Running it requires cloud credits and spending authorization.
